test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: The vehicles carrying inflammable fluids usually have metallic chains touching the ground :

options.text: To protect tyres from catching dirt from ground
To conduct excess charge due to air friction to ground and prevent sparking
